## Content overview

This week, we will focus on the Unix shell, and you will learn:

#### [**Unix shell: working with files**](./w3_1_shellfiles.qmd) (Thursday)

Using Unix commands, how to:

- Create, copy, move, rename and delete directories and files
- Viewing the contents of text files in various ways
- Search within, manipulate, and extract information from text files

<hr style="height:1pt; visibility:hidden;" />

#### [Advanced file management in the shell](./w3_2_shellfiles.qmd) (Thursday)

- Wildcard expansion to select and operate on multiple files at once
- Command substitution to save the output of commands
- For loops to repeat operations, e.g. across files
- Renaming multiple files using for loops

<hr style="height:1pt; visibility:hidden;" />
